standard.notes: bug fix, small feature, refactor, test fix

risky.notes: money or trade execution, state machines, concurrency, auth, secrets, migrations, deploy or CI pipelines, data deletion

design.notes: multi-file design, new module, cross-repo plan; the brief makes it plan first and get the plan reviewed before code

large.notes: features touching many files or parts; steps on terra, judged by Opus

research.notes: gather facts, compare tools, read docs; no code changes

rca.notes: explain a failure, find a root cause; read-only at first

chore.notes: stale PR triage, docs, labels, small config, watches, status checks

review.notes: the separate review thread; never Cursor or GLM

panel.notes: second opinion or panel: not routed here, pass an explicit modelSelection per seat
